verdict.rationale: Time Travel docs show that changed or deleted data stays accessible 'within a defined period' and that deleted objects can be restored, which implies a managed retention window around deletion. Iceberg tables also let users keep data in external storage they manage. None of the evidence shows users configuring the retention period or permanently purging data. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention settings, explicit permanent/irreversible deletion controls, retention policies for data and logs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
